newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MARCORP, MARHOLD PLAN RIGHTS OFFERS.
newsitem.headline: MARCORP, MARHOLD PLAN RIGHTS OFFERS.

text.p: Marlin Corp Ltd and Marlin Holdings Ltd said on Thursday they would raise a total of approximately 195 million rand via rights offers.

Marcorp intends to raise some 120 million rand to enable it to increase its equity base, in order to fund the acquisition of the controlling interest in Kudu Granite Holdings Ltd , the resultant offer to Kudu minorities and reduce debt levels within Kudu.
Marhold plans to raise 75 million rand in order to follow its rights and increase its shareholding in Marcorp.
Last day to register for the rights offers is January 31, the companies said in a notice.
Marcorp announced in December it was acquiring a controlling 56 percent stake in Kudu from Germany's Deutsche Steinindustrie AG in a deal worth 50 million rand.

The acqusition makes Marcorp one the world's largest producers of granite. The inclusion of the Kudu operations will increase production at its key Rustenburg operation from 30,000 cubic metres a year to over 80,000.
